{{Recipe}}

This is a great [[Cookbook:Salad|salad]], suitable for right before dinner!

==Ingredients==
*3 large leaves Romaine [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]]
*1 medium to large [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]], or 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] cherry/grape tomatoes
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] cheese- and garlic-flavored [[Cookbook:Crouton|croutons]], broken into small pieces
*1 cup crumbled extra-sharp [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|Cheddar cheese]] (preferably aged at least 1 year)
*[[Cookbook:Honey|Honey]] [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon]] salad dressing
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]] (optional)

==Procedure==
#Tear the lettuce into small pieces, and place lettuce in a medium-sized bowl.
#Slice the tomato into small pieces and let them fall into the bowl. If using cherry or grape tomatoes, sprinkle them over the lettuce.
#Sprinkle the crumbled cheese and croutons (and raisins, if desired) over the salad.
#Drizzle the salad dressing over the salad.
#Enjoy!
